label: Not every root gives by a unique optimum, from law-2 premises and two certificates (inference)
rule: A unique optimum fixes the root toward each effect, but the root is two-way toward a contingent one
meaning: Suppose every actual root gives by total optimal output with at most one optimal candidate. The common GOD_4 root n of 0c27f65a (only its root and reach clauses are used) is an actual root. By #1947's law 2 (a conjunct of its premise-free certificate b8ee1a50), from (b1), factive giving, the common root, necessary roots and some concrete contingent being, n is two-way toward some concrete contingent c: it gives c being at w and not at some accessible world v where it exists. By the first conjunct of #1737's certificate (1822b59d), total optimal output with a unique optimum gives cross-world stable output on n's giving-output profile, which is being fixed toward every being given at w (law 1); so n gives c being at v: contradiction. Constructive.
